Veterans Benefits: Kentucky exempts military retired pay for service members who retired before January 1, 1998; later retirees may use Kentucky's general pension exclusion, with split-era Schedule P treatment for pre-1998 service. Kentucky also provides veterans preference, education and dependent tuition benefits, veteran license plates, disabled sportsman licenses, hunting and fishing benefits, and state veterans centers.
